purpose: Pre-register an explicitly post-collection but pre-unblinding all-nine analysis of the intact V179 cohort. The V179 collection plan failed only because E10 was misclassified as a reachable positive mechanism seed using a V170 counterfactual rather than its direct V176 parent state. No V179 throughput, completion, latency, cost or QPR value has been read. This plan keeps all nine runs, fixes only the result-blind parent-control mapping and reachability classification, and retains every frozen performance gate without adding, deleting or rerunning a seed.

result_blind_parent_control_mapping.no_activation_control_requirement: zero bounded-single activation windows and exact assignment-sequence equality to the nearest frozen parent control
result_blind_parent_control_mapping.reachable_seed_requirement: positive bounded-single activation count, exact parent-control prefix equality before the first activation, and first assignment divergence at that activation
result_blind_parent_control_mapping.other_invariants: primary heavy-count guard, parents-completed bypass, short-work threshold, queue router, references, QC, pairing and runtime identity remain exactly as checked by the V179 blind audit

performance_evaluation_after_new_blind_a.candidate_rows: all nine V179 rows without filtering
performance_evaluation_after_new_blind_a.throughput_selected_nine_paired_gate: at least five selected seeds beat paired Orion
performance_evaluation_after_new_blind_a.qpr_selected_nine_paired_gate: at least seven selected seeds beat paired OCS
performance_evaluation_after_new_blind_a.full_throughput_gate: mean strictly greater than Orion 1.4741 and at least 12 of 20 wins
performance_evaluation_after_new_blind_a.full_qpr_gate: both QPR means strictly greater than OCS 0.055577160345697, at least 12 of 20 wins, and all twenty finite
performance_evaluation_after_new_blind_a.joint_pass: new result-blind audit and every unchanged performance gate pass

execution_policy.if_joint_failure: retain all nine V179 runs and retire this analysis without subset reporting
execution_policy.if_joint_success: close homogeneous low training and authorize a separately committed confirmation plan; do not claim paper superiority from training data
